# ESP
## ESP (Library.ESP)
- Library.ESP:Add(settings) returns an object with Hide, Show, ToggleVisibility, SetEveryColor and Destroy.
- Library.ESP:Clear() and Library.ESP:Destroy().
- Library.ESP.GlobalConfig: IgnoreCharacter, Rainbow, Billboards, Distance, Highlighters, Tracers, Arrows, Boxes2D, Boxes3D, Skeleton, Health, Font.
- Library.ESP.Players (Enabled, HideTeammates, AllyColor) and Library.ESP.Settings (the template), with Library.ESP:ApplyTemplate().
- Library.ESP:AttachPreview(viewportHandle) draws over a Tab:Viewport. Library.ESP:Build(tab, window) makes the ESP tab.
- tests/esp_test.lua: plain Lua 5.3+ test of ESP.luau against a Roblox API mock. Geometry, rules, components and cleanup only, no rendering.
- Name above the 2D box, distance below it; GlobalConfig.Meters (default on, studs x 0.28) and GlobalConfig.DynamicText (default on) scale the text with the box.
- Visible check: GlobalConfig.VisibleCheck (colours: VisibleColor, HiddenColor), GlobalConfig.VisibleOnly (hides the hidden). Ray from camera to head.
- Extras, all off by default: GlobalConfig.HealthText, HeadDots, ShowTool, Fade (FadeStart 0.6 of max distance), FOV (FOVRadius), Crosshair.
- ESP tab: Library.ESP:Build(tab, window) makes one page per feature (Players, Names, Boxes, Highlight, Tracers, Health, Skeleton, Arrows, Visibility, Overlay, Colours, Preview). Each page turns its own feature on; everything is off by default; no master switch; players are always watched.
- ESP extras: GlobalConfig.TeamColours, FriendColours (FriendColor wins over team), DisplayNames, TeamName, Radar (RadarRange studs, RadarSize px, dots turn with the view), VisibleEvery (frames between visible checks, default 3). The highlight and the arrow use the same colour rules as the rest of the ESP.
- Wall check (GlobalConfig.VisibleCheck): green if any point (head, body, hands, feet; R6: six parts) can be reached from the camera, red if none can; non-colliding and see-through parts and other players do not block; behind the camera is red. VisibleEvery defaults to 1.
- ESP: GlobalConfig.ShowDead (grey dead players), GlobalConfig.NearestLimit (0 keeps everyone). Presets: ESP:Export() returns JSON text, ESP:Import(text) returns true or false, reason.
- Presets apply at once: every ESP control is refreshed after ESP:Import (silently, without its callback). Players stay enabled whatever a preset says.
- ESP is in ESP.luau, its own file: `Library.ESP = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/longtokaiikari-source/HawkTokaiLib/refs/heads/main/ESP.luau"))()(Library)` loads it after the library. Nothing loads it by itself.
- ESP is off by default: nothing loads ESP.luau until a script loads it.
- ESP health bar: the fill takes its colour from health (green full, yellow half, red low) inside a black outline; ESP.HealthColor(fraction) returns that colour. Radar: a marker for your own character in the middle, pointing up.
- ESP damage numbers: GlobalConfig.DamageText writes a red -N or green +N over a player when its health changes; each rises and fades in about 0.9s; off by default (Health page toggle 'Damage numbers').
- ESP speed: GlobalConfig.Speed adds the horizontal speed beside the distance (m/s, or st/s with Meters off); falling does not count; off by default (Names page toggle 'Speed').
